calls.title: funnels continued
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team discussed the strategy for funnel metrics, deciding to postpone supporting slices in the initial version to avoid complexity and UI overload. The group reached a consensus that slices would be applied only at the funnel level, while separate metrics could be created for step-level slicing. Furthermore, dimensions would effectively break down funnels for better user comparisons. Technical complexities were acknowledged, with a commitment to clarifying terminology around filters, slices, and dimensions. The initial implementation will focus on user-level analysis, leaving session-level funnel counting for future updates. To enhance user experience, there will be an emphasis on clear visuals and consistent design elements that help non-technical users navigate funnel metrics.
calls.keywords: funnel metrics, slices, dimensions, funnel creation flow, conversion steps, session analysis
